title: Cosmic Sea Turtle Vortex
description: A detailed sea turtle with a shell decorated in fleur-de-lis patterns swims through the center of a swirling, colorful vortex. The background features a dramatic spiral of fiery oranges, deep reds, and purples blending into a ghostly white skeletal figure on the right side, surrounded by abstract symbols and dripping paint effects.
prompt: A highly detailed sea turtle with vibrant green and blue scaly skin swims through a swirling cosmic vortex. Its shell is decorated with yellow and green fleur-de-lis patterns. The vortex spirals with intense fiery orange, red, and deep purple hues blending into a ghostly white skeletal figure on the right. Abstract symbols and dripping paint effects frame the scene in a surreal, mystical composition.
